links.outcome: Cumulative cases per bed and patient-reported access to health information in randomised deployment
links.effect: 8-month randomised deployment in 8,240 inpatients: cumulative cases per bed increased by 9.7% and patient-reported access to health information rose.
links.quote: In an 8-month randomised deployment involving 8,240 inpatients, OrthoPilot was embedded in routine hospital care, increasing cumulative cases per bed by 9.7% and raising patient-reported access to health information.

links.outcome: AI performance compared with orthopaedic physicians across the care pathway
links.effect: OrthoPilot surpassed experts with 25 years of experience in diagnostic reasoning, clinical decision-making and management planning in a reader study with 81 physicians.
links.quote: In a reader study, OrthoPilot was compared with 81 orthopaedic physicians across the complete care pathway, surpassing experts with 25 years of experience in diagnostic reasoning, clinical decision-making and management planning.

links.outcome: Full-chain management success for physicians with AI in prospective decision-making study
links.effect: OrthoPilot increased full-chain management success by 10.6% across 1,870 complex cases.
links.quote: In a prospective physician decision-making study of 1,870 complex cases, OrthoPilot increased full-chain management success by 10.6%.

screen.reason: Evaluates OrthoPilot (an LLM-powered system for longitudinal musculoskeletal management) across benchmarks, a reader study, a prospective physician study, and an 8-month randomized clinical deployment involving 8,240 inpatients.
